notes:
• Claude knows when you read a chat on your phone. While a chat is open in Pocket, Claude in Conductor gets notes from Pocket's Settings with every prompt: keep replies short, don't ask you to look at the Mac, send links over Tailscale. You can edit the notes or turn this off in Settings → Claude. Pocket Host adds a hook to `~/.claude/settings.json` for this the first time a phone asks. iPhone and Android alike; not for Codex chats.
• Pocket on iPad is laid out like Conductor: the workspaces in a sidebar, the open workspace beside them with its chats as tabs under the pull request bar (switch, close and open chats there), the chat at a readable width, and keyboard shortcuts (⌘↩ send, ⌘T new chat, ⌘W close chat, ⌘⇧] / ⌘⇧[ next and previous chat, ⌘⇧N new workspace). The iPhone, narrow iPad windows and Android stay as they are.
• Videos in chats: videos attached to a prompt and videos an agent puts in its reply (`!…`) show as a thumbnail with a play button, and a tap plays them (in Quick Look on iPhone, with Share to save them; in a full-screen player on Android, with Share). Photo Library now offers videos too, and Choose File takes them; they go to the Mac as they are, up to 1 GB. MP4, M4V and MOV. Needs the new Pocket Host.
• Android app: "Scan QR code" no longer closes Pocket right away. The scanner couldn't start in the released app.
• iPhone: opening a workspace slides the chat's title in smoothly instead of jumping and cutting it off differently halfway through.
